description: Header file defining vectorized operations and conversions for 16-bit floating point types (bfloat16 and float16) using AVX2 intrinsics, shared functions for vec256_bfloat16.h and vec256_half.h.

classes.name: Vectorized16
classes.description: Template class for vectorized 16-element float16 or bfloat16 data using AVX2 intrinsics, supporting various operations like load, store, blend, comparison, and mathematical functions.

methods.name: cvtbf16_fp32
methods.description: Converts bfloat16 stored in __m128i to float32 in __m256.

methods.name: cvtfp32_bf16
methods.description: Converts float32 in __m256 to bfloat16 stored in __m128i or __m256i.

methods.name: cvtfp16_fp32
methods.description: Converts float16 in __m128i or __m256i to float32 in __m256.

methods.name: cvt_to_fp32
methods.description: Template function to convert from __m128i or __m256i to float32, specialized for BFloat16 and Half types.

methods.name: cvt_from_fp32
methods.description: Template function to convert from float32 in __m256 to bfloat16 or float16, with optional comparison mode.
